Standard — matching MATLAB Parallel Server + Slurm
Bridge — remote MATLAB + Parallel Server + Slurm
No available cluster profiles were discovered.

ManagedSlurm: KSSOLV creates and maintains the Slurm profile; SSH, MATLAB root, and scheduler settings are required. ExistingMatlabProfile: use a MATLAB cluster profile already returned by parallel.listProfiles on this client.
Select the platform associated with the existing cloud profile. MathWorks Cloud Center uses the linked AWS account; AWS and Private Cloud use an administrator-provided or imported profile.
Readable name of the cloud deployment, cluster, or stack used to identify the selected resource. Leave blank when the existing profile fully identifies it. Example: kssolv-production
Region containing the cloud resource; it should match the existing cloud profile. For a private cloud, use the logical region defined by its administrator. Example: us-east-1
Name of an existing MATLAB cluster profile on this client. It must be returned by parallel.listProfiles. Use Discover Profiles to select one. Example: mySLURMCluster
Profile used by remote MATLAB when Bridge mode calls parcluster. It must exist in remote MATLAB, and its Parallel Server release must match that MATLAB. Example: mySLURMCluster
Remote MATLAB installation root; do not enter bin/matlab. Connection discovery can populate it automatically. Standard mode requires the client release. Example: /opt/MATLAB/R2026b

Writable absolute remote directory for job files, state, and results. It can initially be blank and populated by connection discovery. With a jump target, the login host, target, and workers must all see it. Example: /scratch/$USER/kssolv-jobs
Maximum workers this configuration may use. Connection discovery populates it from the remote profile or hardware; a manual value must not exceed scheduler or license limits.
Parallel-pool workers requested by each remote job. Connection discovery can populate it, and the value must be between 0 and Maximum workers. 0 creates no pool; start with 1–4 for small tests.
Slurm partition used for submission. Leave blank to use the cluster default. Examples: compute or gpu
Slurm billing or project account. Enter it only when the cluster requires --account. Example: project123
Slurm QoS name controlling queue priority or resource limits. Leave blank to use the account default. Example: normal
Maximum job duration in [days-]hours:minutes:seconds format. Examples: 01:00:00 or 2-12:00:00
Safe arguments appended to sbatch. Enter arguments only; do not include sbatch, semicolons, pipes, or command substitution. Example: --constraint=avx2 --mem=16G
Root of an existing remote KSSOLV Toolbox when ClusterInstalled is selected; it must contain +kssolv. AttachCurrentToolbox does not use this field. Example: /shared/apps/KSSOLV-Toolbox
Select only when local MATLAB and the cluster access the same job-storage directory at the same path. Otherwise files are mirrored over SSH. A laptop connecting to HPC normally leaves this cleared.
Select when remote workers use MathWorks online licensing. Normally leave cleared for a network license or MATLAB Parallel Server license server.
MATLAB license number used for online licensing. This field is enabled only with MATLAB online licensing; use the number shown in the MathWorks account.

Shell script run after SSH reaches the target environment and before resource discovery or remote commands. It must exit with status 0; otherwise discovery or task execution stops immediately. Examples: source /etc/profile module load matlab/R2024a export TMPDIR=/scratch/$USER/tmp

Handle interactive prompts produced by the post-login command in table order. The regular expression matches prompt text, and the credential label describes the secret to enter. Each rule responds at most once. Example pattern: (?i)password.*: Example credential label: node7 SSH password

AttachCurrentToolbox uploads the current KSSOLV installation on first use and caches it remotely by source-content hash. Later jobs reuse the cache; code changes create a new cache automatically. ClusterInstalled uses an existing remote KSSOLV installation and requires the Cluster KSSOLV root field. Root example: /shared/apps/KSSOLV-Toolbox
